processes.name: Lac Operon Regulation
processes.description: The lac operon is a classic example of prokaryotic gene regulation (Jacob & Monod, Nobel Prize 1965). Maximum complexity flowchart with 63 nodes, 5 OR gates (orange), 2 AND gates (lavender), showing environmental sensing, transport, regulatory logic gates, transcription control, and metabolic pathways.

processes.name: DNA Replication Initiation at oriC
processes.description: DNA replication initiation in E. coli occurs at oriC through DnaA protein regulation. Contains 1 OR logic gate (DnaA-ATP availability check).

processes.name: Transcription Initiation and Regulation
processes.description: Transcription initiation by RNA polymerase holoenzyme with sigma factor regulation. Contains 2 OR logic gates (sigma factor availability, regulatory factor type).

processes.name: Cell Cycle Control and CDK Regulation
processes.description: Eukaryotic cell cycle control via CDK-cyclin regulation with checkpoints. Contains 3 OR gates (Start, DNA replication, spindle assembly checkpoints).

processes.name: Two-Component Signal Transduction (EnvZ-OmpR)
processes.description: EnvZ-OmpR system senses osmotic stress and regulates porin expression. Contains 2 OR gates (osmolarity check, OmpR-P level) and 1 AND gate (OmpR-P DNA binding requires phosphorylation AND promoter availability).

processes.name: SOS Response to DNA Damage
processes.description: RecA-LexA mediated response to DNA damage activating 40+ repair genes. Contains 3 OR gates (ssDNA detection, LexA levels, repair completion) and 1 AND gate (RecA filament requires ssDNA AND RecA availability).

processes.name: Heat Shock Response and Protein Quality Control
processes.description: σ32-mediated heat shock response with DnaK-DnaJ and GroEL-GroES chaperone systems. Contains 2 OR gates (temperature threshold, feedback assessment) and 2 AND gates (both chaperone systems require two components).

processes.name: Catabolite Repression and Global Carbon Control
processes.description: cAMP-CRP global regulation ensuring preferential glucose utilization. Contains 2 OR gates (glucose presence, cAMP levels) and 2 AND gates (operon activation requires CRP-cAMP AND specific inducer).

processes.name: Stringent Response and ppGpp-Mediated Growth Control
processes.description: RelA-mediated ppGpp synthesis in response to amino acid starvation, regulating ~500 genes. Contains 2 OR gates (uncharged tRNA detection, ppGpp levels) and 2 AND gates (RelA activation and RNAP regulation).
